question: Simplify: 5 (1)/(2) - [ 2 (1)/(3) div left{ (3)/(4) - (1)/(2) times (8)/(3) right} ]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply BODMAS: First solve the innermost product, then the brackets, and finally the subtraction.

Inner curly bracket: 3/4 − (1/2 × 8/3) = 3/4 − 4/3 = −7/12.

Outer square bracket: 7/3 ÷ (−7/12) = 7/3 × (−12/7) = −4.

Final calculation: 11/2 − (−4) = 11/2 + 4 = 19/2.

**∴ The correct answer is 19/2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 5 1/2 − [ 2 1/3 ÷ { 3/4 − 1/2 × 8/3 } ]

Method: BODMAS Rule (Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction)

⇒ Convert mixed fractions: 5 1/2 = 11/2 and 2 1/3 = 7/3

⇒ 11/2 − [ 7/3 ÷ { 3/4 − (1/2 × 8/3) } ]

⇒ 11/2 − [ 7/3 ÷ { 3/4 − 4/3 } ]

⇒ 11/2 − [ 7/3 ÷ { (9 − 16) / 12 } ]

⇒ 11/2 − [ 7/3 ÷ { −7/12 } ]

⇒ 11/2 − [ 7/3 × (−12/7) ]

⇒ 11/2 − [ −4 ]

⇒ 11/2 + 4

⇒ (11 + 8) / 2 = 19/2

**∴ The correct answer is 19/2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS / VBODMAS Rule

Operations must be performed in the order: Vinculum, Brackets ( (), {}, [] ), Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Mixed Fraction Conversion

A mixed fraction A b/c is converted to an improper fraction using the formula: (A × c + b) / c.

Division of Fractions

To divide one fraction by another, multiply the first fraction by the reciprocal of the second: (a/b) ÷ (c/d) = (a/b) × (d/c).</p
